Thanks for signing up for the trial. We had you down for a 30-minute integration office hours slot today at 10:00 PT to walk through API keys and the SDK handshake. I didn’t see you join the room and wanted to make sure we get you unblocked quickly.

Attached is a short checklist to review before we next talk: trial-integration-checklist.pdf (APIs, scopes, test dataset, common firewall rules).

Options so we can move forward:
- Rebook a live 30-minute slot (I can propose two times below)
- I can send an asynchronous handoff with the minimal steps + SDK snippet and a quick sandbox key you can use right away
- If you prefer, we can have a short pairing session where I drop into your session and debug live (requires a host share)

If you want to pick a live time, I have: Tue 11/23 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 11/24 08:00–08:30 PT. Tell me which works and I’ll send the calendar invite.

If you want the async handoff, below are the two most common quick fixes we provide for customers who miss office hours:
1) Regenerate sandbox API key and run the SDK init snippet (see example)
2) Confirm outbound firewall allows 443 to inference.redwood.com and that the API key is passed in the Authorization header

Sample SDK snippet (Node):

const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: 'REDACTED_SANDBOX_KEY' });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', prompt: 'Test' });

Let me know preference and I’ll follow up with the concrete artifacts.

Best,

Thanks, Elena — happy to do the async path and keep the live slot as backup.

Sandbox key provisioned: SANDBOX_KEY_9a2f (note: this is a short-lived sandbox token we created; please do not use in production).

Minimal validation steps (copy/paste):
1) Install SDK
   npm install @redwood/inference
2) Set SANDBOX_KEY_9a2f as an env var (Linux/mac): export REDWOOD_API_KEY=SANDBOX_KEY_9a2f
3) Run the quick test (Node):
   node -e "const Redwood=require('@redwood/inference');(async()=>{const c=new Redwood.Client({apiKey:process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});console.log(await c.generate({model:'redwood-small',prompt:'ping'}))})()"

Common errors and fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: ensure the REDWOOD_API_KEY is the exact value (no extra whitespace). If you copied from a PDF or email, regenerate the key from the sandbox panel.
- Timeouts: validate outbound egress on port 443 to inference.redwood.com; try a curl test: curl -v https://inference.redwood.com/health
- SSL handshake failures: ensure your corporate proxy allows TLS 1.2+ and does not intercept certs for that host

I’m attaching a short post-session checklist that covers the next steps if the quick test works: post-session-checklist.pdf

If you want the live pairing after this, I’ve tentatively opened Tue 11/23 10:00 PT on my calendar — please confirm and I’ll send an invite. If that doesn’t work, I can offer Thu 11/25 09:00 PT.

I also opened a HubSpot ticket and attached the sandbox key there so your engineers can reference it: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890

If you run into anything I can triage quickly, ping me directly on Slack or reply to this thread.

Best,
